verdict.rationale: Gram documents and exposes an official 'Platform MCP' server that lets MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) connect directly, plus generates/hosts MCP servers as its core product function, and a CLI/runtime probe confirms the tooling actually installs and runs. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on confirmation that an external agent successfully connects to and operates the Platform MCP server end-to-end.
